values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/troutlake ('This secluded, rustic campground offers 35 sites for tents and small trailers'; 'the campground is split into three small loops'; 'site 19 is a pull-through'; 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (35 campsites), read 2026-10-25. The page no longer states a vehicle length; the derived max_rig_ft 40 (from the note's '10 of which accommodate up to 40-ft') is left as it was.

note: Rustic MI DNR state forest campground in the Gladwin Field Trial Area, 17 mi N of Gladwin via M-18 N and Adams Road; neighbour to House Lake State Forest Campground, with direct access to the 2.8-mile Trout Lake Pathway. 10 of the sites accommodate up to 40-ft vehicles/trailers. Trout Lake has significantly receded since the DNR began an emergency drawdown of the Trout Lake Dam in April 2025 (to prevent a structural failure); the DNR points campers to nearby House and Hoister lakes. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: $20, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day max, 35 sites 'for tents and small trailers' in three loops, site 19 a pull-through (all confirmed, derived -> manual). Season (year-round, roads not plowed) already manual and restated on the page, left. max_rig_ft 40 (derived) left: the current page states no length. Drawdown still on the page (Trout Lake receded; campground not described as closed). Type 'rustic', not equestrian or an ORV camp (ORV 'no'). Directions carry no road warning. Note trimmed of field restatements.
